property_summary: For non-empty _tos, C.transfer always reverts if any sub-call fails, and when all sub-calls succeed it returns true for every input.
C.transfer always reverts when _tos is empty, regardless of the other parameters.
For any non-empty _tos and any from/v, C.transfer returns true and reverts for nothing when the target caddress accepts arbitrary calls (e.g., a contract with a payable fallback).
C.transfer never moves Ether: after any successful transfer call, C's balance remains 0 and the call returns true.
For any non-empty _tos, C.transfer succeeds and returns true when the target caddress has no code (EOA), for every from and v.
transfer reverts when the recipient list is empty, and otherwise returns true exactly when every transferFrom subcall succeeds (a revert of any subcall makes the whole call revert).

property_summary: Calling C.transfer does not move any Ether out of the calling contract: address(this).balance is unchanged after the call, and the call returns true whenever it does not revert.
Calling transfer with a single recipient returns true without moving any Ether out of the caller.
Whenever C.transfer does not revert, it returns true.
C.transfer always reverts when the recipient list is empty, regardless of the other parameters.
For any non-empty recipient list, C.transfer never returns false — if the outer call completes, it always returns true.
